Ingredients

  • Pack of top ramen
  • Pre-shredded cabbage
  • An egg (or two)
  • Teriyaki sauce
  • Water

Stove top, in a pan or pot with a lid: Add ramen and pour in equal parts water and teriyaki. Enough to feel safe the noodles wont burn, but they wont be swimming. Lid placed on and turned to medium heat. 10 minutes later the noodles have absorbed most the liquid. Mix in some cabbage. Lid back on till the cabbage wilts. Finally crack in egg and stirred for a minute.
